title: DC-area forecast: Scattered evening showers before a cooler, wetter weekend
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Clouds increase this evening and a first wave of hit-or-miss showers, maybe a random rumble, move from west to east about 5 to 10 p.m. Temperatures eventually drop from the 80s into the 70s.

What's next? A cold front ushers in a much cooler, unsettled weekend pattern. Showers may still be around in some places early Saturday, then showers or periods of rain at times on Sunday. Drying out and turning genuinely fall-like early to midweek.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Scattered showers become likely during the evening, moving through from west to east after 5 p.m. and into the night as the front pushes through. One or two could bring briefly heavy rain and thunder. Humidity drops off late as lows fall into the mid-50s to low 60s. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Saturday): Some showers could still be around during the morning, especially across the southern half of the region. They should mostly shift south of the Beltway by around noon, perhaps lingering longer in Southern Maryland. Otherwise, it’s cloudy and a bit breezy from the northeast. Highs are held in the 60s. Confidence: Low-Medium

Tomorrow night: Shower odds could rise again for a time during the evening, but especially so later in the night and toward dawn as the next wave of moisture starts to arrive. Lows are mainly in the mid-50s to around 60. Confidence: Medium

Sunday: Rain chances are up by morning, and showers or some steady rain seem likely for at least part of the day. Rain amounts could range from as little as around 0.1 inches north and west of DC, to as much as 0.5 inches or more south and east, before tapering from west to east mid- to late afternoon. Highs are only near 60 to the mid-60s. Confidence: Medium

A look ahead

Sunday night: By evening it should just be a chance of a passing sprinkle. Otherwise mostly cloudy with lows within a few degrees of 55. Confidence: Medium

Skies clear Monday as the front moves offshore. It turns breezy, with highs in the mid-60s to around 70 — genuinely pleasant fall weather. Monday night lows dip to the 40s. Confidence: Medium

Sunny and cool conditions continue Tuesday and Wednesday, with highs in the low to mid-60s Tuesday and mid- to upper 60s Wednesday. Overnight lows drop into the upper 30s to mid-40s — the chilliest nights of the season so far. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for October 2

Record-shattering heat in 2019 pushed temperatures to an incredible 98 degrees—the hottest ever observed in October and a remarkable extension of summer-like conditions.
